CISC/CMPE 454, GPU Volume Rendering
GPU Volume Rendering We'll consider volume rendering of CT data on the GPU. GPU Data The volumetric data must be stored on the GPU: The attenuation values, $\tau [x,y,z]$, are stored in a 3D texture of scalar values.
